nodes.label: Aspect-Ratio-Preserving Letterbox Preprocessing
nodes.rationale: Preserves the input image aspect ratio while adapting RGB frames to the model's required 640×640 input.

nodes.label: Model Binary Integrity
nodes.rationale: The large model binary is excluded from Git while a SHA-256 manifest records its deployed checksum for integrity verification.

nodes.label: Ultralytics Licensing
nodes.rationale: Ultralytics code and pretrained models default to AGPL-3.0, so proprietary or commercial deployment requires appropriate licensing or a differently licensed model.

nodes.label: Local-First Frame Handling
nodes.rationale: Frames remain on the Raspberry Pi unless explicitly copied elsewhere, reducing unnecessary disclosure of recorded footage.

nodes.label: Confidence Threshold Tuning
nodes.rationale: Lowering the default 0.50 confidence threshold to 0.35 increases sensitivity for scenes where weaker detections should be retained.

nodes.label: Motion Area Threshold Tuning
nodes.rationale: Increasing the minimum changed-region area reduces false positives, while decreasing it makes motion detection more sensitive.

nodes.label: Exclusive Camera Ownership
nodes.rationale: Only one program can own the Raspberry Pi camera at a time, so the continuously running camera-stream service was disabled.

nodes.label: Responsible Surveillance Use
nodes.rationale: Recording should occur only with permission; footage should not be uploaded by default, and the starter project deliberately omits face recognition and identity matching.

nodes.label: Non-Destructive Service Disablement
nodes.rationale: The conflicting service was stopped and disabled to release the camera, while its source files and service definition were preserved.
